description: This file defines a serializer for the DateOnly type, providing methods to write and read DateOnly values to and from a wire format. It is part of the Orleans.Serialization framework, specifically for .NET 6.0 or later.

classes.name: DateOnlyCodec
classes.description: Serializer class for the DateOnly type, implementing reading and writing logic for serialization purposes.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a DateOnly value to the buffer with type information.

methods.name: WriteField (static)
methods.description: Writes a DateOnly value to the buffer without type information, using aggressive inlining.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a DateOnly value from the buffer.
